title: Safari sandbox container
whyItMatters: Modern Safari keeps cookies, preferences, tab state and extra profiles in its container. Missing it would leave out signed-in session data.
source: Browser forensics reference for Safari container layout: ~/Library/Containers/com.apple.Safari/Data/Library - https://www.browserforensics.app/en/blog/safari-history-file-locations
notes: TCC-protected like ~/Library/Safari; needs Full Disk Access on a live system. Safari 17+ extra profiles and cookies live under Data/Library. Metadata only.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Safari export the bookmarks you keep with File > Export > Bookmarks before clearing anything.
steps: Quit Safari so its container is not in use.
In Safari choose History > Clear History and clear all history.
Delete the Safari container folder named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Signed-in website sessions, cookies and extra Safari profiles on this Mac are lost. The Apple Account itself is unchanged.
cleanup.source: Apple Support, Clear your browsing history in Safari on Mac: https://support.apple.com/guide/safari/clear-your-browsing-history-sfri47acf5d6/mac
